remarks:
If you have been looking for an affordable piece of ground to call your own during hunting season, this 7.6-acre recreational parcel in Stockton deserves a look. With approximately 350 feet of road frontage, the property starts with extremely thick cover near the road before opening into an attractive stand of mature timber.
Once inside the woods, rolling topography creates a surprising amount of character for a parcel this size. Mature trees, changes in elevation, thick edge cover, and visible deer sign combine to create a compact piece of hunting ground with several natural travel corridors and potential stand locations.
Toward the southern end, the terrain drops away to a creek, adding another habitat feature and natural transition area. Mapped wetlands are present on the property, making this best suited as a recreational and hunting parcel rather than a traditional building lot.
For someone looking for their own piece of Western New York woods without purchasing a large tract, these 7.6 acres offer thick cover, mature timber, water, varied terrain, and the opportunity to establish a private hunting setup.
Do not enter the property without an agent.
